pages.text:
Cracks Naphtha or Refinery Gas with steam into olefins, the start of plastics.
# Building
A solid 3x3x3 box of Steam Cracker Casings, with the Steam Cracker Controller in the middle of the bottom of one side, facing out. Formed, it becomes a cracking furnace: a refractory-lined box with the fire glowing at its peep holes, its radiant tubes rising into headers on the roof, a transfer line to the quench drum, and a short stack.

# Cracking
100 mB Naphtha and 50 mB Steam make 50 mB Ethylene, 25 mB Propylene, 10 mB Hydrogen and 5 mB Heavy Oil a second, using 60 HU/t at 800°C or hotter. Refinery Gas gives more Ethylene and Hydrogen and less Propylene. Speed Upgrades make it faster.
# Ports
- Input: the feed (and steam) in. Steam: steam only.
- Heat: heat in (a Fuel Burner on Naphtha, or a Firebox Array, gets it hot enough).
- Output: Heavy Oil out. Gas Output: all three gases, or Ethylene, Propylene and Hydrogen each out of its own port.
The recipes are data-driven (arcforge:steam_cracking).

# Propylene
A new gas. The Chemical Reactor turns 120 mB of it into 2 Polypropylene Sheets, a plastic any recipe that takes arcforge:plastics accepts.
